keywords_en: criminal; crime of poisoning; second instance; basic people's court; high people's court; Henan Province; natural person; criminal law; distinction between crime of poisoning and crime of sabotaging collective production; whether it endangers public security; uphold the original judgment; poisoning; poisoning and killing farm cattle; reselling dead cattle for profit
full_text_en:
Zhao Nao — case of poisoning

Defendant: Zhao Nao, also known as Zhao Zongwen, male, 45 years old, a farmer of Qingjian Village, Potou Town, Jiyuan City, Henan Province. Arrested on April 2, 1996.

Defense Counsel: Ma Jinhua, lawyer of Jianfeng Law Office, Jiyuan City, Henan Province.

The People's Procuratorate of Jiyuan City, Henan Province, initiated a public prosecution against the defendant Zhao Nao for the crimes of poisoning and sabotaging collective production, and brought the case to the Jiyuan People's Court.

The People's Procuratorate of Jiyuan City alleged: Between July and October 1995, the defendant Zhao Nao, in order to make profits from reselling dead cattle, purchased gaseous rodenticide and sprinkled it on pieces of steamed bread or vegetable leaves. He poisoned on seven occasions on roads, threshing grounds, or vegetable fields in the village, thereby poisoning to death seven head of draught cattle owned by six peasant households including Liu Zhengyun and Zhao Fuyong, valued at RMB 9,700. His conduct violated Article 106 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (1979) and constituted the crime of poisoning. Between July 1995 and March 1996, Zhao Nao used the same method and on 62 occasions placed poison in the cattle troughs of villagers, thereby poisoning to death 62 head of draught cattle owned by 33 peasant households including Cheng Shouxiang and Zhao She, valued at RMB 100,780. His conduct violated Article 125 of the Criminal Law of 1979 and constituted the crime of sabotaging collective production. The procuratorate requested a judgment according to law.

The Jiyuan People's Court found through trial: Between July 1995 and March 1996, the defendant Zhao Nao, in order to make profits from reselling dead cattle, purchased gaseous rodenticide from local shops and markets, sprinkled it on vegetable leaves or pieces of steamed bread, and placed the poison on roadsides, threshing grounds, vegetable fields, or in the cattle troughs of villagers. He poisoned to death 62 head of cattle, valued at RMB 99,880. Specifically: 4 head owned by Zhou Guo of the Second Residents' Group of Machang Village; from the Fifth Residents' Group of the village: 2 head owned by Liu Li, 1 head by Yang Wei, 2 head by Liu Xiu, 1 head by Yang Yong, 2 head by Du Mulin, 4 head by Wang Sheng, 2 head by Bai Shiliang, 2 head by Yuan Tao; from the Sixth Residents' Group: 3 head owned by Liu Zhifu, 1 head by Liu Zhigui, 1 head by Liu Jun, 1 head by Liu Guoying, 1 head by Zhu Long, 1 head by Zhang Tiancai, 1 head by Liu Zhiping, 2 head by Bai Shiming, 2 head by Liu Zhengyun, 2 head by Liu Xuemei, 1 head by Liu Xitang, 1 head by Zhang Zonglai, 2 head by Zhang Zhiming, 1 head by Liu Mihu, 1 head by Zhou Yin; from the Seventh Residents' Group: 1 head owned by Zhao Fuyong, 1 head by Yang Zhuan, 4 head by Zhao Fa, 4 head by Zhao Jin, 6 head by Zhao She; from the Eighth Residents' Group: 1 head owned by Zhao Zongbao, 1 head by Cheng Shoutian, 1 head by Cheng Shouxiang; from the Tenth Residents' Group: 1 head owned by Liu Guangping, 1 head by Liu Zhan. Zhao Nao resold part of the dead beef and made profits from it.

The above facts are confirmed by the statements of victims Zhou Guo and Zhao Fuyong regarding the time, place, and symptoms of the sudden death of their self-raised draught cattle; the testimony of witnesses Zhao Dongli and Liu Kaifen regarding the defendant Zhao Nao's poisoning of the cattle; the testimony of witness Wang Chunge regarding Zhao Nao's purchase of rodenticide; the testimony of witnesses Yuan Ping and Zhao Liguo regarding their purchase of dead cattle sold by Zhao Nao and Zhao Dongli; the record and photographs of 7 unused rodenticide phials seized from Zhao Nao's home by the public security authorities after the incident; and the appraisal conclusion of the price bureau on the valuation of the dead cattle. The defendant Zhao Nao confessed to the poisoning facts without reservation, and his confessed facts were consistent with the statements of the victims and witnesses. The facts are clear, the evidence is sufficient, and the findings are fully established.

The Jiyuan People's Court held: The procuratorial authority alleged that the defendant Zhao Nao poisoned to death 69 head of cattle. Among them, the death of 7 head of cattle was not confirmed due to insufficient evidence and thus was not recognized. Zhao Nao, aiming at making profits from reselling dead cattle and targeting cattle without specific objects, openly placed poisonous rodenticide, poisoning to death 62 head of cattle valued at RMB 99,880, causing heavy losses. His conduct endangered the property safety of an unspecified majority of persons, violating Article 106, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law of 1979, and constituted the crime of poisoning. Zhao Nao's criminal conduct not only caused property losses to citizens but also made nearby villagers lose their sense of security, allowed feudal superstitions to emerge and spread, and disrupted public order. The circumstances and consequences of Zhao Nao's crime were particularly serious, and he should be severely punished. Zhao Nao's criminal conduct was continuous. If considered for a single incident of poisoning cattle, Zhao Nao's poisoning might have been directed at a specific target and bore the characteristics of the crime of sabotaging collective production. However, viewing Zhao Nao's entire criminal process, his conduct infringed upon the property of an unspecified majority and endangered public safety. The procuratorial authority, by using whether Zhao Nao committed poisoning in a public place as the threshold, distinguished his conduct as constituting the crimes of poisoning and sabotaging collective production respectively, which was improper. Therefore, the procuratorial authority's accusation that part of Zhao Nao's conduct constituted the crime of sabotaging collective production was an incorrect characterization of the offense; the opinion of Zhao Nao's defense counsel that Zhao Nao's conduct only constituted the crime of sabotaging collective production was not adopted. Accordingly, on June 26, 1997, the Jiyuan People's Court rendered the following judgment:

The defendant Zhao Nao was found guilty of the crime of poisoning and sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life.

After the judgment was announced at first instance, the defendant Zhao Nao refused to accept it and appealed to the Henan High People's Court on the ground that he had a good attitude of admitting guilt and should be given a lighter punishment.

The Henan High People's Court held after trial: The Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China had already come into effect on October 1, 1997. For the poisoning conduct of the appellant Zhao Nao, the penalty provided for in Article 115, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law is consistent with that in the Criminal Law of 1979. In accordance with Article 12 of the Criminal Law, Zhao Nao should be investigated for criminal liability in accordance with the law in force at the time of his conduct. Zhao Nao, for private gains, openly placed poisonous rodenticide, poisoning to death over 60 head of cattle valued at over RMB 90,000, and his conduct already constituted the crime of poisoning, for which he should be severely punished according to law. The original judgment was accurate in conviction, appropriate in sentencing, and lawful in trial procedure. Zhao Nao's grounds for appeal could not be established. Accordingly, on October 14, 1997, the Henan High People's Court, in accordance with Item (1) of Article 189 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, ruled:

Appeal dismissed and the original judgment affirmed.

Pursuant to the provisions of the Supreme People's Court authorizing high people's courts to approve certain death penalty cases, the Henan High People's Court approved the judgment of the Jiyuan People's Court finding the defendant Zhao Nao guilty of the crime of poisoning and sentencing him to death, with deprivation of political rights for life.
